modules.name: ontologylab.chatstore
modules.rationale: Workspace chat transcript store used by the HTTP chat surface; not part of pack bytes.

secondary_stages.why: Owns a separate sqlite file and schema so conversation never ships inside a pack.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Corrupt result_json/steps_json is silently replaced with {} / [] so history still renders.

modules.name: ontologylab.mcp_protocol
modules.rationale: Newline JSON-RPC framing for the single local MCP stdio transport.

modules.name: ontologylab.mcp_runtime
modules.rationale: In-process MCP tool/resource registry and dispatcher; not a second server.

modules.name: ontologylab.mcp_server
modules.rationale: The one MCP server: PackSession tools/resources over verified pack snapshots.

secondary_stages.why: list_packs/try_autoload discover published packs via packbuilder.scan_packs.

hidden_fallbacks.what: get_embedder('auto') uses MiniLM when sentence-transformers imports, else HashingEmbedder; uncached HF load also falls back to hash (allow_download default false).
get_reranker('auto') returns CrossEncoder or None; never downloads (HF_HUB_OFFLINE in CrossEncoderReranker).
Reranker slot is hardcoded get_reranker('auto') with no operator nameable contract.

engine_slot.interface: ontologylab.embeddings.get_embedder(name, allow_download=False) plus session._active_embedder model-match gate

modules.name: ontologylab.mcpb
modules.rationale: Zip an already-built pack plus a shim that relaunches ontologylab.mcp_server.

secondary_stages.why: Bundled server/main.py is only a trampoline into mcp_server.main.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Bundling reads manifest.json + existence of pack.sqlite with no verify_pack/activate_pack; tamper is deferred to later MCP load.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_completeness
modules.rationale: Extraction-stream completeness gate consumed by the pack builder before export.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Pre-attribution same-document citations fall back to every candidate extraction_run for that document instead of a typed unknown.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_readiness
modules.rationale: Generation/C-036 publication authorization; also a second CLI that builds v2 packs.

secondary_stages.why: python -m ontologylab.pack_readiness --publish calls build_pack with evidence_mode (default full).

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_receipt_seal
modules.rationale: Re-derives content-addressed Step-7 receipt IDs and the inventory root.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_source_fingerprint
modules.rationale: Live document id/hash witness written into a v2 pack and rechecked on verify.

hidden_fallbacks.what: load_source_fingerprint returns None on any parse/shape error; callers treat absence as mismatch/false rather than a typed refuse at this layer.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_v2_closure
modules.rationale: Collects the evidence-self-contained v2 member set, copies tables, and writes evidence bytes.

secondary_stages.why: resolve_v2_closure re-reads a packed tree for the standalone validator.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_v2_derive
modules.rationale: Re-derives v2 counts, exclusions, capabilities, and packed evidence availability.

secondary_stages.why: resolve_pack_evidence/fact_receipts are called from PackSession query/evidence reads.

hidden_fallbacks.what: _derive_capabilities silently returns the unreviewed/base tuple whenever C-036, witness, ledger, or seal does not line up.
_count swallows sqlite3.OperationalError and returns 0, so missing tables look like empty counts.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_v2_manifest
modules.rationale: After payloads exist, inventories the tree and writes the owner-read-only v2 manifest.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_v2_validate
modules.rationale: Read-only packed-v2 closure completeness checks invoked from verify_pack.

hidden_fallbacks.what: If a v2 pack does not advertise reviewed/evidence-self-contained and does not claim a closure, _validate returns without checking members.

modules.name: ontologylab.pack_verifier
modules.rationale: Standalone byte verifier with a typed v1-compatible and v2-strict contract.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Missing pack_schema_version defaults to 1, so an unsigned manifest is parsed as legacy v1 rather than refused.

modules.name: ontologylab.packbuilder
modules.rationale: Single build_pack entry that snapshots the verified subgraph; internally forks v1 vs v2.

secondary_stages.why: Build also detects and summarizes communities into the pack.
scan_packs/list_packs is the discovery API used by MCP and HTTP.

hidden_fallbacks.what: evidence_mode is None selects the v1 copy/manifest path; operator CLI/HTTP never pass the flag, so v2 is implicit opt-in via pack_readiness only.

modules.name: ontologylab.packdiff
modules.rationale: Operator diff of two published packs after verified snapshot activation.

modules.name: ontologylab.serve
modules.rationale: Alternate uvicorn launcher; inventory.unreachable (not imported from main/server/mcp).

secondary_stages.why: Would start the local web app if invoked as ontologylab-serve / python -m ontologylab.serve.

modules.name: ontologylab.tui
modules.rationale: Generic job status-line helper with fan_in 0; not an MCP/pack consume TUI.

modules.name: ontologylab.verified_pack_reader
modules.rationale: Verify-copy-reverify serving snapshot; the only honest pack open for MCP/diff/list.

secondary_stages.why: inspect_verified_manifest is also the list/scan gate for published directories.

findings: TWO publish products, ONE builder with a hidden fork: build_pack/_build_pack_unlocked (packbuilder.py:801/:298) is the only writer, but evidence_mode is None takes v1 (packbuilder.py:365, manifest write :766) while evidence_mode set collects v2 (collect_v2_closure :377, finalize_v2_manifest :764). main.py build-pack parser (main.py:2097) and cmd_build_pack (main.py:1319) never pass evidence_mode; POST /packs/build (routes.py:2714) and chat action build_pack (routes.py:2450) call the same v1 build_pack (routes.py:2730). The v2 publish path is pack_readiness.main --publish (pack_readiness.py:176) defaulting --evidence-mode full (pack_readiness.py:147). Not two builders, but two operator pipelines and no single linear Publish stage.

packbuilder.py is a mega-module (1002 LOC): verified-subgraph copy, method-pack, communities/summaries, v1+v2 manifest, scan/list, pack_sqlite_path, rewrite guard. Cross-stage shortcut: Synthesize (communities at packbuilder.py:561) runs inside Publish.

Consume is one server, three support modules: mcp_server.main (mcp_server.py:1320) constructs PackSession (mcp_server.py:253) and McpApp (mcp_server.py:1404). mcp_runtime.McpApp (mcp_runtime.py:152) is the registry; mcp_protocol.run_stdio (mcp_protocol.py:13) is framing; mcpb.build_mcpb (mcpb.py:103) is a zip, not a server. Docstrings still mention FastMCP (mcp_server.py:9,:965) but FastMCP is not imported.

Audit item 3 (_verified_pack bypass) is NOT present on current MCP named-pack reads. _verified_pack is gone; get_schema named pack uses opened_verified_pack (mcp_server.py:544), resource_* uses _store_for->_activate (mcp_server.py:625/:485), get_staleness ephemeral open uses _activate (mcp_server.py:371), resource_manifest uses inspect_verified_manifest (mcp_server.py:637). Remaining unverified pack-byte reads: mcpb._load_pack_manifest (mcpb.py:55) and scan_packs first-pass json.loads of manifest.json (packbuilder.py:904) before inspect_verified_manifest (packbuilder.py:948).

Embedder/reranker auto offline contract (audit item 7): embeddings.get_embedder auto (embeddings.py:233) MiniLM-or-HashingEmbedder with HF_HUB_OFFLINE in SentenceTransformerEmbedder (embeddings.py:183); rerankers.get_reranker auto (rerankers.py:103) CrossEncoder-or-None with HF_HUB_OFFLINE (rerankers.py:73). MCP inserts embedder at mcp_server.py:1375 (operator --embedder) and hardcodes reranker auto at mcp_server.py:715. Model mismatch disables vectors (_active_embedder mcp_server.py:723) rather than scoring with the fallback model.

Import cycle on the v2 publish spine: pack_v2_closure.collect_v2_closure imports authorize_publication (pack_v2_closure.py:144); pack_readiness.main imports pack_v2_closure and packbuilder (pack_readiness.py:170). Second cycle: pack_verifier._validate_packed_v2 imports pack_v2_validate (pack_verifier.py:382); pack_v2_validate imports pack_verifier.ManifestV2 (pack_v2_validate.py:20).

Duplicated v1/v2 verify implementations live in one slot (pack_verifier.py:525 match) plus a weaker v2 skip (pack_v2_validate.py:158) and silent count/capability degrade (pack_v2_derive.py:268/:148). parse_manifest defaults missing schema version to v1 (pack_verifier.py:287).

serve.py and tui.py are inventory.unreachable orphans. serve is still a console script (pyproject ontologylab-serve) that would launch the web app (serve.py:16); tui.Tui (tui.py:21) is an unused job status printer, not a pack consume TUI.

PackSession.document_raw_text (mcp_server.py:942) reads snapshot evidence via resolve_pack_evidence but is not registered in build_mcp_app (mcp_server.py:1049); a Consume API exists beside the tool surface.
